verdicts.reason: Art. 21 of D.Lgs. 231/2007 says that information on beneficial owners (titolari effettivi) is sent to the Registro delle imprese 'ai fini della conservazione in apposita sezione'. That supports the printed name, a dedicated beneficial-ownership section of the Register of Companies.

The live site refused the connection, so I read the archived copy. Its header reads 'Vigicrues.gouv.fr Le service d'information sur le risque de crues des principaux cours d'eau en France', which matches the printed name and its description.

The FAQ page says the Rijksregister is currently managed by the Algemene Directie Identiteit en Burgerzaken 'van de Federale Overheidsdienst Binnenlandse Zaken' (FPS Interior). The home page, in context, says that same directorate manages the Rijksregister. Both match the printed operator.

Art. 2(a) of DPR 313/2002 defines the 'casellario giudiziale' as the database of national interest under art. 60 of the CAD. The only difference from the quote is whitespace: the page prints 'dell' articolo'. The source supports the printed register name.

The live cadastre.gouv.fr page reads 'Le plan cadastral français disponible en ligne est composé de 598747 feuilles de plan...'. That supports 'plan cadastral' as the name of the land-registry system. The printed fact does not use the sheet count.

The government project page covers upgrading the equipment of the Cadastre's own Data Center and Disaster Recovery Center. It mentions no cloud or external provider, which is consistent with a 'national' label. The label is an inference, but it is a reasonable reading of the page.

The SI-TRUST page says the State Trust Services Centre manages the root issuer SI-TRUST Root and the qualified issuers SIGEN-CA and SIGOV-CA, exactly as printed. The gov.si citation also contains its quote, with only whitespace differences, and confirms SIGEN-CA and SIGOV-CA.
The Eurostat API gives 0.1887 EUR/kWh for Romania, 2025-S2, band IC, excluding VAT. Scaled to MWh that is 188.7 EUR/MWh, which matches the printed value.

Ordinance I-45 says the 'Пътна полиция' department/sector at СДВР/ОДМВР for vehicle registration records registration terminations in AIS-KAT. That supports this body as the one operating vehicle registration. The parenthetical expanding СДВР/ОДМВР as MoI regional directorates is a gloss and does not appear in the quote itself.
The Eurostat API gives a total land area of 82494 km2 for Austria in 2026, which matches the printed '82 494 km²'.
The Banco de España page names the 'Central de Información de Riesgos', a public service that institutions report to at the Banco de España. That supports the printed register name and institution.
The page says Lithuania issues citizens 'Lietuvos Respublikos asmens tapatybės korteles (ATK / eID)' as its state-guaranteed electronic identity, which matches the printed name.

§1 AZRG (the AZR-Gesetz) says 'Das Ausländerzentralregister besteht aus einem allgemeinen Datenbestand und einer gesondert geführten Visadatei.' This matches the printed statement, and the page title uses the abbreviation AZR.
The RvIG page names the 'Basisregister Reisdocumenten (BR)' and says it holds information on Dutch travel documents, which matches the printed name.
The Eurostat API gives Hungary's population on 1 January 2026 as 9488428. Scaled and rounded, that is 9.488 million, which matches.
The page says 'Hver måned udbetales løn til ca. 180.000 statslige ansatte.' That matches the printed count and its scope (state employees paid each month).

Government Decree 346/2010 on government-purpose networks defines EDR as a mobile radio network meeting the requirements of Schengen Convention arts. 132 and 44, and calls it a 'digitális kormányzati célú rádióhálózat'. That supports 'Schengen-compliant digital government radio network'. The Pro-M page quote was also found.

The Zakon o sudskom registru says 'Glavne knjige se povezuju u jedinstvenu bazu podataka za Republiku Hrvatsku', which matches the printed statement word for word. The printed text describes the register's structure but does not give a name for it (the law's title calls it the sudski registar).
The Ministry of Education page says the new system will integrate data from existing platforms 'precum SIIIR, PMIPN, Edusal etc.', which matches the printed statement.
The Eurostat API gives a total land area of 303109 km2 for Finland in 2026, which matches the printed '303 109 km²'.
